create.name: Robert Holden
create.bio:
Robert Holden is a British psychologist, author and teacher whose work joins the study of happiness with a spiritual path. In the early 1990s he ran a stress clinic and then The Happiness Project within the National Health Service, and his eight-week Be Happy course was later tested for a BBC documentary. A long-time student of A Course in Miracles, he counts Tom Carpenter as his mentor and has been a patron of the Miracle Network since its start. He came to the Enneagram through Russ Hudson and Don Riso and now holds accreditation from the International Enneagram Association.

His books with Hay House include Happiness NOW!, Shift Happens!, Loveability, Authentic Success, Higher Purpose and Life Loves You, written with Louise Hay. Today he trains coaches in the Enneagram, runs the Purpose Club, and with his wife Hollie hosts Everyday Miracles, an online community that meets weekly to study and live the Course. He also gives small soul retreats, from Los Angeles to the couple's home at Findhorn in Scotland, and has worked as a leadership coach for companies such as Dove, Unilever and Google. His teaching is warm, practical and often funny, asking people to notice how much love they are willing to receive.

courses.title: Shift Happens: 3-Day Soul Retreat (Los Angeles)
courses.description: A three-day retreat for up to forty people at a yoga venue in Los Angeles, drawing on the themes of his book and PBS lecture Shift Happens!. Robert shares the principles and practices of thirty years of teaching about living a more soul-led life.

courses.title: Certified Enneagram Coach
courses.description: An online certification for coaches, therapists, teachers and leaders who want to use the nine Enneagram types with the people they support. Robert covers both the thinking behind the model and how to apply it in sessions.

courses.title: The School of Love: 9-Month Program
courses.description: A nine-month online journey with Robert and Hollie Holden on living a love-centred life, drawing on his book Loveability. Monthly online sessions run through 2027, with an optional in-person gathering.

courses.title: Mystic, Prophet, Activist (Findhorn retreat)
courses.description: A four-day creative retreat for eight people, held by Robert and Hollie Holden at their home in Findhorn, Scotland. Aimed at teachers, writers, artists and coaches, it combines shared meditation, inner work and mentoring on a current project. Places are by application.

courses.title: Everyday Miracles Community
courses.description: An online membership, monthly or yearly, for students of A Course in Miracles, hosted by Robert and Hollie Holden. Members join a live class each Monday and get reduced prices for the couple's Miracle retreats.

free_resources.title: Free Enneagram Quiz
free_resources.description: A short online quiz, about five minutes long, that suggests your Enneagram type and gives a free report that Robert wrote himself. A longer paid report is offered at the end.
